name: personal-browser
description: Personal customizable browser with phone remote

scripts.package: node scripts/write-build-info.js && electron-packager . 'Personal Browser' --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --icon=build/icon.icns --out=dist --overwrite --asar --app-bundle-id=local.personal.browser --ignore='^/(prototype|dist|test|_backup_v1|scripts|build/icon\.iconset)' && codesign --force --deep --sign - 'dist/Personal Browser-darwin-arm64/Personal Browser.app'
scripts.install-app: npm test && npm run package && ditto 'dist/Personal Browser-darwin-arm64/Personal Browser.app' '/Applications/Personal Browser.app'
